pages.text: In Refined Storage 2, fluid management has been integrated directly into the main Grid interface with enhanced performance and improved reliability. The separate Fluid Grid has been removed to provide a more streamlined experience. The main Grid now handles both items and fluids with better organization and filtering capabilities. RS2 features improved fluid handling and better mod compatibility.

Features:$(li)View all items and fluids in your storage network$(li)Search and filter both items and fluids$(li)Sort by name, quantity, or ID$(li)Group similar items and fluids together$(li)Use Grid Filters to create custom views$(li)View fluid amounts and storage tanks

To use the Grid for fluids:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Right-click to open the interface$(li)Use the search bar to find fluids$(li)Click fluids to extract them$(li)Use Grid Filters to customize your view
